svg.title: php -d allow_url_fopen=1 vendor/bin/testbench cms:doctor
svg.text: php -d allow_url_fopen=1 vendor/bin/testbench cms:doctor
pass
php.version PHP 8.5.10 meets the minimum, PHP 8.5.
FAIL
php.allow_url_fopen Outbound HTTP may only go through the egress gateway and its SSRF guard, so
PHP must not open URLs as files.
cause allow_url_fopen is on in this process: fopen, file, copy, SplFileObj
ect and the other file functions fetch http:// and ftp:// URLs.
fix Set allow_url_fopen = Off in the php.ini of every process that runs
Cbox CMS, for example in a conf.d file, or run PHP with -d allow_url_fopen=0.
code doctor_php_allow_url_fopen (violation, blocks the kernel from starti
ng)
pass
laravel.version Laravel 13.4.0 is the major Cbox CMS follows, Laravel 13.
pass
postgres.reachable Connected to Postgres as cms_app@fake:5432/cms (connection fake).
pass
postgres.version Postgres 17.11 meets the minimum, Postgres 17.
pass
postgres.app_role The app role cms_app is not a superuser, has NOBYPASSRLS and NOCREATEROLE,
and is not a member of a superuser, a BYPASSRLS or CREATEROLE role, a role that owns relations or may create objects, or
a predefined role that reaches every table or the server, signals other sessions or reads their query text.
pass
postgres.transaction_timeout transaction_timeout is 5000 ms on the app role cms_app.
pass
postgres.idle_in_transaction_timeout idle_in_transaction_session_timeout is 5000 ms on the app role cms_app.
pass
postgres.prepared_transactions max_prepared_transactions is 0, so no transaction can be left prepared.
pass
postgres.lc_messages Messages are English: lc_messages is C for the role cms_app and C for the r
ole cms_owner, and LC_MESSAGES of the PHP process is C.
pass
postgres.ddl_privileges The app role cms_app owns nothing and cannot create objects in the database
cms or its schemas.
pass
postgres.row_security All 2 tables with row level security in the database cms force it on their
owner.
pass
postgres.extensions The database cms has the extensions the core needs: ltree.
pass
postgres.oldest_xact Within the limits of 5000 ms for a transaction id and 5000 ms for a snapsho
t: no transaction the app role can see holds a transaction id, and none holds a snapshot in this database.
